# SVML samples needed

`.svml` is listed by the public SIMDIS SDK as a SIMDIS 10 view file format. I did not find public `.svml` examples in the public SDK repository or open web search results during this pass.

Do not treat the view format as verified until examples are collected from an installed SIMDIS distribution or official sample-data repository.

Use `scripts/collect_simdis_samples.py` to crawl local installation paths and copy `.svml`, `.view`, `.bml`, `.prefs`, and `.rul` files into the corpus.
